why: The agent lane's preview verdict is written once and read by the Rust driver law and an AJV TypeScript oracle. A script lists progress, checkpoint, yield, complete, cancelled, or a fault carrying either a canonical typed Fault object or foreign raw detail bytes. Typed Fault fields survive the bounded result carrier; foreign bytes remain interactive-job.app-owned-output. The first terminal entry wins and a script without one reaches the bounded preview refusal.

cases.name: a job that completes after its own progress answers every outcome up to its completion
a job that completes on its first step answers one step
a job fault keeps the job's own detail under the app-owned output code

script.fault: puzzle command reducer rejected the admitted operation

fault.message: puzzle command reducer rejected the admitted operation

cases.name: a typed job fault answers its frozen code
a retained reducer refusal preserves its span and named path in canonical fault wire
a job that cancels itself is refused as cancelled
a lease cancelled before the run cancels it before the job's first step
a job still running past the wall budget is refused by name
a job still yielding when the turn budget ends is refused by name

retirement.zeroItem: retain original emission, ephemeral state and completion
retirement.childComplete: retain admitted outer retirement frame until separate whole release
